text:
leah: Opening a small PR to make Function Calling examples compact + add a full appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1499
omar: Compact examples are great for SDK quickstarts. Keep one full JSON example in appendix for debuggers.
kiran: Also found a broken anchor in the JSON schema section. Can you patch that in the same PR?
leah: Yes. Plan: replace inline verbose examples with 2-3 line envelopes, add docs/appendix/structured-output-full.md with full output, update snippets/python/invoke.md and snippets/js/invoke.md, and add a one-line fallback example for raw_text parsing.
marcus: Ops note: runtime now prefers `invocation`; legacy SDKs may still use `tool_call`. Show `invocation` as canonical and call out `tool_call` in parentheses.
kiran: Suggest adding a tiny docs CI grep that ensures every invoke snippet contains either `compact` or `raw_text`.
ci-bot: Reminder: include a CHANGELOG entry and mark PR as docs-only.
leah: Will include link fix, snippets update, changelog, and the CI lint. Requesting reviews from @omar and @kiran.
omar: Happy to review, will do a quick grep for other `tool_call` mentions after you push.
leah: Pushing changes now. Title: "docs: compact invoke envelopes + appendix"
ci-bot: PR updated: link fix pushed, snippets modified, changelog added.
